source_claims.statement: LLMs good at individual threads but stop after one result, underexplore, accumulate assumptions. Fleets cause overlap. XBOW uses short-lived agents, deterministic validators, safety guardians.

research_questions.formulation: What structural systems are required beyond model capability to achieve reliable coverage, validation, and safety at scale?

layer_b_candidate_principles: Short-lived specialized agents under coordinators reduce accumulation of false assumptions
Deterministic validators are required to separate model proposals from verified facts
